kpis.explanation_en: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before other expenses.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates the efficiency of product production and pricing.

kpis.explanation_en: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted, as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Measures operational profitability before certain non-cash and exceptional items.

kpis.explanation_en: Cash generated from operations after deduction of investment expenditures.

kpis.explanation_en: Amount spent to acquire or improve long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect the company's commitment to expansion and maintenance.

kpis.explanation_en: Measures net debt relative to adjusted operating profitability.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to repay debt using its operating profits.

kpis.explanation_en: Current assets minus current liabilities, a measure of short-term liquidity.
kpis.description: Working capital is essential for managing daily operations and short-term financing needs.

kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
